raw.details:
Overview:

A Durga Puja Special

This Pujo, don't just celebrate the power. Build with it.

Durga Puja is all about Shakti, creativity, energy, and coming together. This festive season, BUBBLESORT brings that spirit into technology with SHAKTI Hackathon, a student-focused challenge to turn real-world problems into meaningful tech solutions.

Eligibility & Team:

  • Open to students from a computer-related or technology-oriented academic background
  • 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th Year and Passed-out/Graduated students can participate
  • 1 to 3 members per team
  • Each participant can join only one team
  • Team changes after registration require organizer approval

Hackathon Themes:

AI-Agentic Solutions:

Build AI-powered systems that automate tasks, assist users, manage workflows, or solve real-world problems.

Women Safety / Blockchain:

Build technology solutions focused on women's safety and security. Blockchain-based approaches are welcome where relevant.

Natural Disaster Safety:

Create solutions for disaster preparedness, early warning, emergency response, public safety, or disaster management.

Obesity Control & Medical Fitness:

Build technology solutions focused on obesity prevention and management, including fitness tracking, health monitoring, progress tracking, and lifestyle management.

Heritage & Culture:

Create digital solutions to preserve, explore, promote, or experience cultural heritage.

AR/VR is optional.

Registration & Timeline:

Registration Fee:

FREE

There is no registration fee for participating in the SHAKTI Hackathon.

Registration Platform:

Registration will be conducted through the official Unstop event page.

Participation Capacity:

Maximum: 100 Participants

Round 1 | Idea Submission:

27 September 2026, 10:00 AM IST → 21 October 2026, 12:00 PM IST

Participants must submit their project idea through a PPT/PPTX presentation.

The presentation should clearly explain:

Problem → Proposed Solution → Technology → Implementation Approach → Expected Impact

Only submissions completed within the given timeline will be considered for the Final Round.

Round 2 | Final Video Presentation:

23 October 2026, 12:00 AM IST → 25 October 2026, 12:01 AM IST

Finalist teams must submit a video presentation of their completed project.

The video should clearly present:

  • Problem
  • Proposed solution
  • Technology used
  • Implementation
  • Key features
  • Impact of the project

Teams should also demonstrate their working project and explain its functionality.

The submitted video will be considered for the final evaluation.

Project Rules:

  • Projects must align with one official hackathon theme
  • Web applications, mobile applications, AI/ML solutions, software platforms, and working prototypes are allowed
  • AI tools are allowed for coding, research, debugging, documentation, brainstorming, and development
  • APIs, open-source libraries, frameworks, datasets, and other public resources are allowed
  • Pre-built or ongoing projects are allowed, but teams must clearly disclose what was already built and what was newly developed
  • Participants must be able to explain and understand the work submitted
  • Plagiarism, fraudulent submissions, impersonation, or misrepresentation may lead to disqualification

Evaluation, Prizes & Opportunity:

Evaluation: 30 Marks

PPT / Idea Presentation: 15 Marks

Final Project / Video Presentation: 15 Marks

Projects may be assessed on:

  • Problem understanding
  • Solution quality
  • Technical implementation
  • Functionality
  • Creativity and approach
  • Presentation

Prizes:

  • 1st Place
  • 2nd Place
  • 3rd Place

Top-performing teams will receive prizes and recognition from BUBBLESORT.

Diversity Advantage · Extra Points:

Teams with female participants will receive extra points during evaluation as part of the Shakti initiative.

Top 10 Internship Opportunity:

The Top 10 participants/teams may be considered for an unpaid internship opportunity with BUBBLESORT, subject to selection, availability, and applicable terms.

Participation in the hackathon does not automatically guarantee an internship.

Submission & Presentation:

Round 1:

PPT/PPTX Idea Submission

Teams must submit their proposed solution within the Round 1 timeline.

The PPT should cover:

Problem → Solution → Technology → Implementation Approach → Expected Impact

Round 2:

Final Video Presentation

Selected finalist teams must submit a video presentation of their completed project.

The video should demonstrate the working project, explain its key features and functionality, and cover:

Problem → Solution → Technology → Implementation → Impact

Project Ownership:

If using an existing or ongoing project, teams must transparently explain what was developed before the hackathon and what was newly developed or improved for SHAKTI Hackathon.

Pujo Mode: Activated:

The pandals will be glowing.
The dhak will be playing.
The group chats will be chaotic.

Somewhere between "Pujo ashche!" and "bro, where is the PPT?", you might build something awesome.

Come with an idea. Come with your squad. Come with your laptop.

PUJO. CODE. CREATE.

27 SEP → 21 OCT | Round 1 Idea Submission
23 OCT → 25 OCT | Round 2 Final Video Presentation

FREE | 1–3 Members per Team

Choose a problem. Build a solution. Show your Shakti.
